The metallic powders were obtained by atomization technique - a rapid solidification method with nominal composition of NiAl – 28Cr- 5.5Mo-0.5Zr (at.%) and were sieved to smaller than 60 μ m for sintering.
The prepared powders were put into the vacuum furnace (ZR50c-8T, Nonferrous Metal Casting Co., Ltd, China) at room temperature for hot pressing and then cooled with the furnace.

The compact sample defined as sample A with mirco-sized and nano-sized network microstructure was sintered at 1225 ◦ C and the soaking time was 60 min (1225 ◦ C/60 min) with a heating rate of 10 ◦ C/s.
For comparison, another compact sample defined as sample B was sintered at 1300 ◦ C and the soaking time was 30 min (1300 ◦ C/30 min), which shows the evolution of the microstructure.
